summary.name: Udacity
summary.one_liner: Udacity is an online learning platform offering tech courses and Nanodegree programs in programming, data science, artificial intelligence, and digital marketing.
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes online courses in programming, data science, artificial intelligence, and digital marketing. It highlights a Generative AI Nanodegree program that starts with an introductory course, moves to text generation with Large Language Models, covers image creation in computer vision, and ends with real-world applications such as chatbots and AI agents. The listed Generative AI program is rated 4.9, marked Intermediate, and takes 50 hours. The page does not describe pricing, certificates, or enrollment details beyond these.
